name: sum-of-evens
prompt: Print the sum of the even numbers from 1 to 100.
solution: (display (let loop ((i 1) (sum 0)) (if (> i 100) sum (loop (+ i 1) (if (even? i) (+ sum i) sum)))))

name: keep-odd
prompt: Keep only the odd numbers of the list (1 2 3 4 5 6 7) and print the result as a list: (1 3 5 7)
solution:
(define (keep-odd l) (cond ((null? l) '()) ((odd? (car l)) (cons (car l) (keep-odd (cdr l)))) (else (keep-odd (cdr l)))))
(display (keep-odd (list 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))

name: sort-numbers
prompt: Sort the numbers 3 1 2 5 4 into ascending order and print them as a list: (1 2 3 4 5)
solution:
(define (insert x l) (cond ((null? l) (list x)) ((< x (car l)) (cons x l)) (else (cons (car l) (insert x (cdr l))))))
(define (sort l) (if (null? l) '() (insert (car l) (sort (cdr l)))))
(display (sort (list 3 1 2 5 4)))

name: word-count
prompt:
Count how many times each word appears in the string "a b a c b a", then print one line per word, for a, b and c in that order, like this:
a: 3
b: 2
c: 1
solution:
(define words (string-split "a b a c b a" #\space))
(define (count w l) (cond ((null? l) 0) ((string=? w (car l)) (+ 1 (count w (cdr l)))) (else (count w (cdr l)))))
(for-each (lambda (w) (display w) (display ": ") (display (count w words)) (newline)) (list "a" "b" "c"))
